description.value: Combat actions and maneuvers for every creature. Granted by Alivas's Box of Triggers; homebrew maneuvers are shown only when that setting is on.

description.chatFlavor: Replaces one attack: move a creature within reach aside.
Replaces one attack: make the target drop something it holds.
Replaces one attack: restrain a creature you are grappling.
Replaces one attack: throw a creature you are grappling.
Bonus action: Acrobatics to move through a creature's space this turn.
Bonus action: Athletics to barge through a creature's space this turn.
Try to break free of a grapple.
Climb onto a creature at least two sizes larger.
Try to shake off a creature climbing on you.
Give an ally Advantage on their next ability check.
Distract an enemy within 5 ft; an ally's next attack against it has Advantage.
Stealth check against DC 15; on a success you are Hidden.
Wisdom check to find something.
Intelligence check to recall or deduce.
Charisma or Wisdom check to sway a creature.
Use an object that needs an action.
Extra movement this turn.
Your movement provokes no Opportunity Attacks this turn.
Defensive stance until the start of your next turn.
Hold an action and a reaction for a trigger (note only).
Let go of a creature you are grappling.
Fall Prone at no cost.
End Prone; this costs half your Speed.
Pick up a willing or unconscious ally within reach.
Put down a creature you are carrying.

action.text: Cast a spell with a Verbal component.
